collection.commit_note: HF collection metadata does not have a Git repository commit; API exposes last_updated. Checked baseline description and each item note immediately before mutation; no atomic parent/CAS API exists for these fields.
collection.description_before: Four EXL3/Trellis quants of Qwen3.8-27B optimizing fidelity, flexibility, capacity, or 262k context. Every KLD measured vs BF16.
collection.description_after: Four runtime-specific Qwen3.8 EXL3 builds. v5 10M shared-head, body-only KL vs BF16; advisory, not a quality ranking. Context tested separately.

items.note_before: Recommended default. 21.61 GB download, 20.31 GiB resident, KLD 0.007406 body-only / 0.007532 as served, 178 s cold start, attention fixed at K6.
items.note_after: Serialized K6 attention; no encode cache. v5 10M shared-head, body-only KL: 0.002760 nats (legacy fp32 reducer; advisory). 21.61 GB recorded download, 20.31 GiB resident; 178 s cold start in the reported profile. Prior v3 full-suite 0.007406 body-only / 0.007532 as-served remain separate historical results. Not a task-quality or native-serving ranking.

items.note_before: Flexible edition. 30.57 GB download because attention ships BF16 and is encoded at load (957 s cold, cache required), but the width is a launch-time knob: K6 0.008157, K5 0.012135 (~206k context on 32 GB), K4 0.027530.
items.note_after: Flexible attention width (K6/K5/K4 at launch). v5 10M shared-head, body-only KL: 0.003210 nats (legacy fp32 reducer; advisory). 30.60 GB recorded download, 20.32 GiB resident. Prior v3 width-ladder values 0.008157 / 0.012135 / 0.027530 remain historical, not v5 measurements. See the card for per-profile capacity and cold-start evidence.

items.note_before: Capacity edition. 17.89 GiB resident is the only build in this family that fits native 262,144 context on a 32 GB card (289,577 KV tokens measured), at KLD 0.030736.
items.note_after: Capacity edition: 17.89 GiB resident; 262,144 context qualified on RTX 5090 in the documented profile. Not the only family build with native-context evidence: the context edition also qualifies. v5 10M shared-head, body-only KL: 0.010604 nats (legacy fp32 reducer; advisory). Prior v3 full-suite 0.030736 is a different panel result, retained on the card.

items.note_before: Context edition. Native 262,144 context on a 32 GB card with int8 embeddings (18.13 GiB resident), retrieval verified at 227,334 tokens, KLD 0.009738 - 26 % below official FP8.
items.note_after: Context edition: 262,144 on RTX 5090 under the documented int8-embedding/MTP-3/8.4 MP profile; memory is profile-specific. v5 10M shared-head, body-only KL: 0.003509 nats WITHOUT int8 overlay or candidate head (legacy fp32 reducer; advisory). Prior v3 0.009738 used the int8 overlay; it is not this v5 result. Context qualification is separate from fidelity; no universal FP8 ranking.

limits: No new model-forward, capture, score or paid run.
No project tests/build/lint during concurrent batch.
Advisory comparability and missing provenance remain disclosed, not fabricated or promoted.
Original receipts retain historical precision labels and scientific numbers; interpretation corrected additively.
Historical candidate capture loss prevents full re-derivation from public captures without new work.
Existing plots and structured artifacts are unchanged, not regenerated.
suggested_correction_journal_entry: 2026-09-08 — Qwen collection/card protocol reconciliation. The four malaiwah/Qwen3.8-27B model cards now name the v5 10M-position shared-head, body-only KL estimand at the top and disclose float32_reduce_legacy, advisory/inspection-only status, incomplete revision/harness/stack/replay provenance, and the separation from native-head, int8-overlay, MTP, vision and long-context profiles. Unqualified best-fidelity titles and automatic common-mode-floor cancellation claims were corrected. The replica experiment is not a converter-population variance bound; historical missing candidate captures mean full-ladder capture replay still needs new work. Historical v3 full-suite and corrected-subset values, v4 and v5 shard-0 results remain distinct and unchanged. Collection notes formerly presented v3 values as current summaries; they now explicitly report v5 means 0.002760 / 0.003210 / 0.010604 / 0.003509 for hydrated / flexible / K4 / context while retaining the old values with v3 attribution. The stale K4-only native-context claim was withdrawn because the context edition also has documented hardware qualification. The context collection note no longer conflates its legacy int8-overlay result or profile-specific resident memory with the no-overlay v5 result. Only README.md and its DOCS-SHA256SUMS entry changed per model; all measured table values, fenced structured/example blocks, plots, receipt files and weight files remain unchanged. Five pinned cumulative receipts were downloaded and matched their registry SHA-256 values. Published commit and main-branch README bytes were fetched and verified, repository blob maps confirmed exactly the two documentation files changed, and the public collection plus all four rendered cards were browser-verified. Collection metadata has no Git commit ID; its before/after note text and last-updated timestamp are preserved in the accompanying JSON audit. No measurements, paid work, GitHub commit/push, project tests, build or lint were run by this slice.
